method: Independent manual source challenge, no application execution or credentials read
severity_assessment: HIGH conditional on cross-operator recovery; same-user proof only rotates bearer. Privilege escalation NOT established.

evidence.evidence: wasPending self-change proof invokes shared Api.LoginByPinAsync before checking returned user identity; no restoration on mismatch and no CurrentUser update.
Successful login installs returned bearer into process-shared HttpClient before returning UserSummaryDto to proof caller.
One Api property shared with separately mutable CurrentUser and HasPermission derived from CurrentUser; no automatic identity synchronization.
Station-global users.change-pin owner key restores typed original request independently of current user.
Normal lower-camel actor binding rejects mismatched identity; protects many writes and limits impact. Separate SEC001 casing issue must not be silently combined into a demonstrated exploit.
Self path validates OLD PIN; admin path authorizes users_manage and prohibits owner target. Proof belongs to recovery of old-PIN replay, not unauthenticated credential bypass.

preconditions: An unresolved retained self-PIN-change exists and user explicitly retries it.

A successful proof login returns a bearer. Cross-operator restart can yield original actor token while CurrentUser remains the new operator; wrong-user proof could also replace token before equality fails.
A real PIN must authenticate: no arbitrary account/token invention.
counterevidence: Same original user successful proof preserves principal and merely rotates token.
Failed login does not install bearer.
Returned identity equality prevents declaring wrong-user proof a successful PIN change, but occurs after bearer installation.
Normal server actor matching and command authorization can reject mismatches; no guaranteed financial privilege escalation.
affected_workflows: Subsequent shared-API reads/writes after proof identity differs from visible CurrentUser
recommended_remediation: Use a separate non-installing credential-proof operation and explicit journal actor ownership; do not silently switch shared session during proof.
required_tests: Fake transport proof returns different principal; verify original shared header and CurrentUser unchanged after rejected proof.
Recovered request from operator A under logged-in B requires explicit recovery ownership decision.
Same-user successful proof reconciles completed PIN change without altering unrelated session identity.
independent_scope: This finding only; does not certify other UI or SEC001 findings.
